raw_line: Any Hydro Reaction Team for Furina (Furina — Skirk — Escoffier — Dahlia)

raw_line: Free-To-Play Team Comp With Furina (Furina — Yanfei — Sucrose — Barbara)
description: F2P team comp for Furina. Yanfei is the DPS while Sucrose shreds Hydro and Pyro Resistance. Barbara activates Hydro Resonance for more HP on her and Furina while also providing healing.
